description: Unit tests for the Android proxy configuration service in Chromium, testing proxy resolution logic, configuration changes, and scheme-specific proxy rules.

classes.name: TestObserver
classes.description: Observer class for proxy configuration changes, records current config and availability.

classes.name: JavaLooperPreparer
classes.description: Prepares Java's Looper for Android tests.

classes.name: ProxyConfigServiceAndroidTestBase
classes.description: Base class for Android proxy config tests, manages configuration, observer, and proxy override methods.

methods.name: SetUp
methods.description: Initializes test environment and adds observer.

methods.name: AddProperty
methods.description: Adds a proxy setting property to the configuration.

methods.name: GetProperty
methods.description: Retrieves a property value from configuration.

methods.name: ProxySettingsChangedTo
methods.description: Simulates a change in proxy settings to specific host, port, PAC URL, and exclusion list.

methods.name: ProxySettingsChanged
methods.description: Simulates a change in proxy settings.

methods.name: TestMapping
methods.description: Tests the proxy resolution for a given URL against expected output.

methods.name: SetProxyOverride
methods.description: Sets proxy override rules with optional bypass list and reverse bypass flag.
